summary.goal: Define all core TypeScript types and Zod schemas for the cultivate pipeline. This is the contract surface — every pipeline stage, adapter, job, and API handler depends on these types. Covers Signal, Cluster, Greenhouse, Recommendation, ScoringFactors, CultivateWeights, CultivateConfig, CultivateOutcome, FilterRule, SourceConfig, IngestionJob, RawEvent, NormalizedEvent, ExtractionResult, StepProvenance, SignalSource, AuthConfig, AuthorType, AdapterType, SourcePreset, and all enums. Model names configurable via CULTIVATE_EXTRACT_MODEL and CULTIVATE_CLUSTER_MODEL env vars.

acceptance_criteria.description: SignalStatus enum: pending, filtered, processing, scored, clustered, decayed, dead_lettered

Signal schema: id, greenhouse_id, source_type, external_id, title, body, author, author_type, url?, score, scoring_factors, cluster_id?, status, provenance, tags[], created_at, updated_at, linked_plan_id?
Greenhouse schema: id, name, description?, mode (discovery|refinement|focused), keyword_require[], keyword_exclude[], source_ids[], created_at, updated_at
Cluster schema: id, greenhouse_id, label, summary, signal_count, trend (rising|stable|declining), velocity_weekly, velocity_monthly, created_at, updated_at
Recommendation schema: id, greenhouse_id, title, reasoning, confidence, supporting_signal_ids[], supporting_cluster_ids[], created_at
ScoringFactors schema: recency, specificity, source_authority, repetition, emotional_intensity, strategic_fit, actionability, content_quality — all number(0-1)
CultivateWeights schema: same 8 keys as ScoringFactors, values are weight multipliers, keyed per greenhouse_id
CultivateConfig schema: weights per greenhouse, filter_rules enabled/disabled, tier1_strictness, tier2_threshold, model overrides
CultivateOutcome schema: signal_id, action (link|dismiss), greenhouse_id, metadata?, timestamp
FilterRule schema: id, name, description, type (reject|boost), condition, enabled, effectiveness (signals_matched, false_positive_rate)

SourceConfig schema: id, name, adapter_type, preset?, endpoint_template?, auth?, poll_interval_ms, greenhouse_ids[], health (healthy|warning|unhealthy|disabled), consecutive_failures, last_error?, enabled, created_at
AuthConfig schema: type (bearer|api_key|oauth2|basic|hmac), encrypted_credentials
AdapterType enum: poll_api, webhook, push, structured_pull
AuthorType enum: user, team, bot, system, unknown
RawEvent schema: source_config_id, external_id, raw_payload, received_at
NormalizedEvent schema: title, body, author, author_type, url?, source_type, external_id, occurred_at
ExtractionResult schema: themes[], entities[], actionability_hint, quality_hint, strategic_fit_hint
IngestionJob schema: id, filename, status (pending|chunking|processing|complete|failed), total_chunks, processed_chunks, greenhouse_id, created_at
StepProvenance schema: step, timestamp, details? — tracks which pipeline stages a signal passed through
SourcePreset schema: id, name, description, adapter_type, endpoint_template, auth_type, default_poll_interval_ms, tier
All types exported from package root: import { Signal, Greenhouse, Cluster, ... } from '@plannr/cultivate'
Zod schemas enable runtime validation of adapter output, LLM extraction responses, config, and API request bodies

steps.title: Define core enums and primitive types
steps.description: Create src/domain/types.ts. Define Zod schemas and inferred types for all enums: SignalStatus (pending|filtered|processing|scored|clustered|decayed|dead_lettered), GreenhouseMode (discovery|refinement|focused), ClusterTrend (rising|stable|declining), AdapterType (poll_api|webhook|push|structured_pull), AuthorType (user|team|bot|system|unknown), AuthType (bearer|api_key|oauth2|basic|hmac), FilterRuleType (reject|boost), IngestionJobStatus (pending|chunking|processing|complete|failed), SourceHealth (healthy|warning|unhealthy|disabled). Also define ScoringFactors schema with all 8 numeric(0-1) fields.

acceptance_criteria.description: All enum schemas validate only their allowed values
ScoringFactors schema validates all 8 fields as numbers between 0 and 1

steps.title: Define Signal, Greenhouse, and Cluster types
steps.description: In src/domain/types.ts, add Zod schemas for Signal (with id, greenhouse_id, source_type, external_id, title, body, author, author_type, url?, score, scoring_factors, cluster_id?, status, provenance:StepProvenance[], tags[], created_at, updated_at, linked_plan_id?), Greenhouse (id, name, description?, mode, keyword_require[], keyword_exclude[], source_ids[], created_at, updated_at), and Cluster (id, greenhouse_id, label, summary, signal_count, trend, velocity_weekly, velocity_monthly, created_at, updated_at). Define StepProvenance schema (step, timestamp, details?).

acceptance_criteria.description: Signal schema validates all required fields and optional cluster_id, url, linked_plan_id
Greenhouse schema validates mode as GreenhouseMode enum
Cluster schema validates trend as ClusterTrend enum
StepProvenance tracks pipeline stage progression

steps.title: Define config and weights types
steps.description: Add CultivateWeights schema (same 8 keys as ScoringFactors but as weight multipliers, not bounded 0-1), CultivateConfig schema (weights: Record<greenhouse_id, CultivateWeights>, filter_rules: Record<rule_id, {enabled}>, tier1_strictness: number, tier2_threshold: number, extract_model?: string, cluster_model?: string), CultivateOutcome schema (signal_id, action: link|dismiss, greenhouse_id, metadata?, timestamp), and Recommendation schema (id, greenhouse_id, title, reasoning, confidence: number, supporting_signal_ids[], supporting_cluster_ids[], created_at).

acceptance_criteria.description: CultivateConfig includes model override fields for extract and cluster
CultivateOutcome action is strictly link or dismiss
Recommendation confidence is a number

steps.title: Define pipeline types (RawEvent, NormalizedEvent, ExtractionResult)
steps.description: Add pipeline data flow types: RawEvent schema (source_config_id, external_id, raw_payload: unknown, received_at), NormalizedEvent schema (title, body, author, author_type, url?, source_type, external_id, occurred_at), ExtractionResult schema (themes: string[], entities: string[], actionability_hint: number, quality_hint: number, strategic_fit_hint: number). These represent the data transformations through the intake pipeline stages.

acceptance_criteria.description: RawEvent.raw_payload accepts unknown (any JSON from source)
NormalizedEvent is the adapter output contract — validated by Zod before entering pipeline
ExtractionResult hint fields are numbers for LLM-provided scores

steps.title: Define SourceConfig, AuthConfig, and SourcePreset types
steps.description: Add SourceConfig schema (id, name, adapter_type, preset?, endpoint_template?, auth?: AuthConfig, poll_interval_ms, greenhouse_ids[], health: SourceHealth, consecutive_failures: number, last_error?, enabled: boolean, created_at), AuthConfig schema (type: AuthType, encrypted_credentials: string), SourcePreset schema (id, name, description, adapter_type, endpoint_template, auth_type, default_poll_interval_ms, tier: number), FilterRule schema (id, name, description, type: FilterRuleType, condition: string, enabled: boolean, effectiveness: { signals_matched: number, false_positive_rate: number }), and IngestionJob schema (id, filename, status: IngestionJobStatus, total_chunks, processed_chunks, greenhouse_id, created_at).

acceptance_criteria.description: SourceConfig.health validates against SourceHealth enum
AuthConfig.encrypted_credentials is opaque string (actual encryption handled by auth-encryption feature)
FilterRule.effectiveness tracks signals_matched count and false_positive_rate
SourcePreset.tier is a number representing the source tier (1-5)

steps.title: Export all types from package index
steps.description: Create or update src/domain/index.ts (or src/index.ts depending on package structure) to re-export all public types and Zod schemas from types.ts. Ensure consumers can import { Signal, Greenhouse, Cluster, ScoringFactors, CultivateConfig, RawEvent, NormalizedEvent, ExtractionResult, SourceConfig, FilterRule, ... } from the cultivate package. Export both Zod schemas (for runtime validation) and inferred TypeScript types (for compile-time usage).

acceptance_criteria.description: All Zod schemas are exported (SignalSchema, GreenhouseSchema, etc.)
All inferred TypeScript types are exported (Signal, Greenhouse, etc.)
All enums are exported
